that-time-of-the-month.desc: It was at age 6 that I realized I did not like being human. The dead of summer had come (or, as some called it, a particularly warm day in March) and I, becoming repulsed by my flesh, asked my father if it were at all possible to flay myself. To upturn my skin…

33-rozalie.desc: When they say the danger's over but you see the sunset red, And the glow upon the gloaming fills your warning heart with dread, Look upon the faces dearest to you in that dark'ning hour — Know that they are brilliant also, gleaming with such lambent power.

32-polyxeni.desc: Should the tally of the dead feel too profound for math to count, And the losses keep on piling to a staggering amount, Keep your focus off the rattling of the ragged spectre's chain, And your eye upon the prize: those precious bodies which remain.

31-wilhelmina.desc: When you're underneath the cover and you're looking for your mates, When you're crawling through the muck and mud to learn their sorry fates Under rotten timbers fallen, or in craters hewn by shell, It's not easy to remember that the home front's also hell.

30-bastien.desc: Underfoot and out of sight is where we make our homes, In the subterranean shadows like a pack of busy gnomes Keeping up the nerve to dwell within demands an iron will, But it helps to know that always there are deeper places still.

29-amelia.desc: When waiting is a habit 'neath the weighty weight of soil, Keeping time and counting moments, curling inward like a coil Tense and nervous and distracted, 'til resumption of our toil, We then spring to life so precious, and our blood is brought to boil.

afterglow.desc: My eyes are glued to the clear sky. Point-blank. I'm lost in the clusters of bright stars, each of them organized in pretty patterns. Above the horizon, the moon radiates with glory, supported by the faint halo surrounding it. Everything underneath is illumina…

tomorrows-dogs.desc: The joke goes like this. Three guys find a genie. It doesn't matter how. They each get one wish. Besides that, no rules. The first guy strides up to the genie and states, "I wish to live forever". A snap of its fingers, and bam, the genie makes him an O-5. He…

28-eszter.desc: Every acre of this sodden earth has known the tread of feet There is presence in the particles, its story incomplete Yet can those who dug before us help to further dig the hole? Does the genius of a loci have its own peculiar soul?

27-dolores.desc: When the planning meets the fighting and the planning loses out, And there's no-one left upon the field who wields sufficient clout To keep the battle rolling, or to bring it to a close Someone always takes initiative; but who? 'til then, who knows?

hopelessly-devoted-to-you.desc: When I first saw you, amorphous and gelatinous, I guess I recognized something. You had something I lacked. It's like you came to me in a vision, but you were real. You were right in front of me. I couldn’t look away.

beyond-the-door.desc: You would not know what you were looking for unless you had been clued in before. This far down in the doldrums, it is easy to lose yourself in the countless hallways and offices. It is hidden within a bureaucratic machine, one designed to eat away at the tax…

shared-interest.desc: Site-43: Lambton County, Ontario, Canada "Is she still out there?" "Are we gonna send someone out to talk with her?" Jay shook their head, and let go the Venetian blinds. They snapped back into place, hiding the OSAT Humvee and its Jeep escorts from view. Aero…

26-jay.desc: There are those who watch the battlements, and those who bunker down, And those who see the picture whole, who know that soon we'll drown In tears and blood we'll shed from wounds the causes of which stem From lack of visionary thought beyond just "us" and "th…

25-howard.desc: We think we know the men we are when warm beneath the sun, But some truths are deeply buried by us, each and every one We find out who our friends are when we're hard against the scrum: Not the ones ordained for action, but the ones that deign to come.

maria-jones-gets-fired.desc: The following file has been archived following the containment breach of SCP-████. If you wish to edit this file or have any questions regarding its status, please contact the Records and Information Seurity Administration (RAISA) team.

the-butterfly.desc: A raindrop pounds against the great stained-glass window, impacting the vitrified colors with thunderous, if imperceptible, force. The raindrop and the window are both one amongst thousands of fellows. One is the result of hundreds of years of work. The other,…

24-jennifer.desc: No gap or gulf however vast cannot be bridged by love, Though stretching 'cross an ocean or the mound of soil above Yet still there's something to be said for crass proximity And all the daily debts accrued and paid by you, and me.

23-michael.desc: When your faith is faint and foundering, and nothing's gone to plan, Yet we fallen folk in Abaddon have need of more than man, And little's gained from pleading to the powers we've outgrown, And plenty left to pray for — it's no sin to make our own.

22-noor.desc: Woe betide the quartermaster who must lord above these pits, Keeping track of all the bodies warm and all their sundry bits It's a Herculean task to bring to balance our amounts, We who march upon the margins, where it's disarray that counts.

if-horses-were-wishes.desc: It was a dark and stormy night somewhere in Canada, probably near Ipperwash Beach. Actually, it was Ipperwash Beach — Site-43 to be exact. It was here where Placeholder McDoctorate, mad genius extraordinaire and slightly redder than the norm for people in this…

21-daniil.desc: When you shove a bunch of people in a huddle in a hole, There's a curious division of diversity of soul And an equalizing quality to humble, filthy toil; The genius-eating tenor of democratizing soil.

transcendence-pt-3.desc: More by this Author ◀◀ First Entry | ◀ Previous Entry | Next Entry ▶ Andrew’s attempts to solve his Sarkic roommate problem failed, failed, and failed again.

eaterpage.desc: this is the reason why we all will burn in hell. it's worth it, though. HUNGER, the primitive instinct/need/desire/cycle to take sustenance from a life other than your own. YOU'LL NEVER BE ALONE.

ssri-rx-i-tab-qd-po.desc: Yeah, sorry. Ilse couldn't take James so I had to ask Valeria if she could watch him while we did our session, or whatever is left of it.

20-eileen.desc: There's a funny sort of feeling that you get below the grade It can warp your sense of purpose, cause your memories to fade A transformation gradual no soldier can resist, though It's comforting to note that what's important will persist.

a-new-beginning-forgotten.desc: I wake up from the stench of mold emanating from the bathroom. This motel was very cheap when I found it, I never anticipated that it could be THIS BAD.

19-nimkii.desc: When you've spent a couple lifetimes in the trenches with your mates There's a closeness beyond family, or destiny, or fate You become the kind of bosom buds that no-one can deny, In the muck you're forging friendships that on no account may die.

18-nastya.desc: If the jackboots set you running and you've got no place to turn, And you find yourself in trenches strange, it's logical to yearn For that pleasant little hidey-hole away from your new hosts; In long-abandoned dug-outs dwell their own unhappy ghosts.

17-udo.desc: When you're a long-term tenant, you know every glinting grain Like a practical geologist, with silt upon the brain Acreage of dirt becoming well-loved bunks and shelves, And all this filthy tackle mere extensions of our selves.

flowers-for-edie.desc: The only reason Dorothy Burnham doesn't hate her life is because there's not much left to hate. Alarm. Shower. Coffee. Eggs. Drive. Work. Work. Work. Drive. Dinner. Bed. Cry.

16-mali.desc: In digging down beneath the slabs, disturbing ancient earth As bygone Emperors once did to bury things of worth, That in the afterlife they might retain their Earthly spoil, Remind yourself you're not the only thing beneath the soil.

when-the-smoke-clears.desc: Nobody ever talks about the day after an incident. It’s always the day-of that lingers in people’s memories - shouting and screaming, gunfire and blood turned to vapour in the air as your ears ring and you run for the exit while people are shredded in half beh…

15-xinyi.desc: When the nature of a dug-out can't admit for lengthy stays, Though it's fit for purpose now, that's only just a passing phase If long you dwell within it, change its essence to the core, It becomes a different beast, and not a dug-out anymore.

14-flora.desc: Still, there's something to be said for living large within our graves; It's a means to feel akin to our ancestors with their caves Antecedents of those troupers who before us marched to die Serving causes they believed in, never truly knowing why.

scp-173-arc.desc: Item #: SCP-173-ARC Object Class: Euclid Special Containment Procedures: Item SCP-173 was kept in a locked container at all times. When personnel had to enter SCP-173's container, no fewer than 3 used to enter at any time and the door was always relocked behin…

13-nhung.desc: When living in your head too long becomes an awful hassle, There's better uses for a fortified cerebral castle Like shoring up the claims your friends make on their own demesnes; But mind somatic tolls on fending other people's brains.

tomlinson.desc: SCP FOUNDATION INTERNAL MEMO Ethics Committee The following memo is a must-read! Try discussing it with your colleagues.

up-the-cuts.desc: Massachusetts General Hospital: Boston, Massachusetts, USA The frightened diplomat met the brave Weaver, who bestowed upon them a badge of bravery. This gesture filled them with courage to take on their first task.

12-delfina.desc: Though life below the trenches has a homely undertone — There's a postman and a milkman, and a bunk to call your own And your fellows will defend you, never minding what may come — You must not forget: this tunnel's where you're at, not where you're from

11-ilse.desc: When you've left your bunker far behind to taste the summer air, There's a curious desire to reoccupy that lair With its certainty and stasis, its unchanging quantum state But there is no going home for you; the past will never wait.

10-genevieve.desc: There's a kind of camaraderie you can't find on the field But which grows in great abundance underneath an earthen shield A sort of social sorting sets the sterner set apart And allows the seeds of leadership a healthy growing start

a-sunny-day-at-site-27.desc: She opened her eyes. And a rush of excitement came with the ringing alarm. She slid out of bed and grinned at herself in the mirror. Agent Katherine Osmanski could count on one hand the number of times she had been excited for work. Her first day at Site-120 h…

9-melissa.desc: When the battles you've been fighting aren't won by strength of arms, Too much time for contemplation undermines its famous charms A head up in the clouds cannot avoid the thundershock; Though hiding helps the body, the mind could use a walk

strange-supplier.desc: You've been assigned a new mission. A simple one, at least compared to your last assignment. Break into Site-19. Retrieve the item known to the Foundation as SCP-269, along with all relevant documentation. Get the fuck out of there and return to your deploymen…

jamison-mining-company.desc: He sat behind his desk, staring at a ledger that made absolutely no sense. The list didn't read like a mining company. A soft knock at the door broke his concentration.

8-gabrielle.desc: But though the fun on offer there may be a mite unvaried, When all above is bedlam, you'd do best to remain buried At least until uncertainty becomes a toxic dread And safety suffocates; do dare you then stick out your head?

7-clio.desc: When your codebook's out of order and your radio's just out, In static darkness silently you stew within your doubt You learn a truth no fractured pseudo-sanity can soften: A dug-out you can't leave is just a shallow-buried coffin.

life-of-lampeter-palisades.desc: Greetings and salutations, I am Varys Matthau, Orchard’s Parazoologist Premiere! Heh, no, I don’t mean that with certainty, but, as you well know, I am a studious and avid researcher of the biota that call the curious corners of this vast Verse home! From the…

6-randolph.desc: Some are spacious, some are homely, some are just a little strange, But the one thing that they never are is proof against all change Sappers, storms and ordnance must each extract a toll So be sure to keep your feet when next you pop out for a stroll.

5-wynn.desc: When your hat and boots are drying by the fire at the door, And you're cooking up a mystery mash with seasoning and more, Give thanks for all the earth they moved and for the roof they raised, The digging of a dug-out is a feat that must be praised.

i-hate-men.desc: The thought persists in my mind as I watch a woman draped with metallic augments pass by a group of men. They are tall, many gleaming themselves, and confident in their pursuit. A whistle weasels out from one of them; and another beckons for the lady, “Come on…

i-love-you-too.desc: I Love The Theater I Love You, Too Past the outskirts of your town, down a road you would never think to take, lives a gracefully aging movie theater. It hasn't gotten many visitors the past few years, but it's okay with that. After all, it really only needs o…

4-rasmus.desc: But even up and at 'em far above your cozy shelter The guns are blazing fiercely and your wits go helter-skelter There's no man in that land to fight, don't trust you're apt to win it You've left your bivvy open, and your enemy's within it

control-group.desc: I dream of a me without it sometimes, without the biting cold of wave after wave crashing into my base. A world where I knew when the water ended and the “me" started. Free of the tiny droplets within my cracks packing more and more tighter every day, hidden i…

mental-images.desc: I needed to grab something from storage units down at first floor and I overheard people talk under the staircase. I just kept walking. Went back up on the other staircase (god why are these so far apart from each other, it's not like they're hard to build??)

3-imrich.desc: When you're counting down the seconds and each second counts for less, And the products of division are a source of some distress, Try not to let that mental math turn prophet into mourner, Who blinded by his tears predicts himself into a corner

2-pilar.desc: For the essence of a dug-out isn't made with pick and shovel There's factors in its form that wouldn't suit a homely hovel Underneath the earth you know the difference in a second The sickly stench of vigilance, though staler than you reckoned

1-hachiro.desc: When the past is more than prelude, and you live it every hour, The milk of human kindness curdles into something sour, You grow complacent with suspicion's cry, so shrill and feral, And miss the warning wailings of the present, to your peril

0-unsinkable.desc: The ship is sinking. It didn't make sense, but then, nothing did. Her head was swimming, and so was the rest of her. Limbs numb, fingers senseless, she was breathing water as much as air. She couldn't tell which way was up and which was down; she only knew sid…

lamb-in-wolfs-clothing.desc: I strike out three times before I see the tranny across the bar. Tall, redhead, wearing cute glasses with frames as round as the curves filling her tight jeans. She was chatting up some guy with thin wrists sipping a rum and coke and her laughter sounded like…

just-one-dose.desc: "Just one dose should be all you need." The doctor's voice sounded as distant as those in the corridor outside. The bulkhead that separated Freya and the doctor from the rest of the station had been sealed with a gentle, pneumatic hiss. Its frame was outlined…

from-their-lips-to-gods-ears.desc: Grand Cove: Grand Bend, Lambton County, Ontario, Canada Jay stood naked in front of the steamed-up bathroom mirror, analyzing themselves in the reflection.

i-am-your-tyrant.desc: Everything hurt. You sat with your back against a large frozen tree, and tried your best, and failed, to open your left eye. The flesh around it had grown swollen and bruised, sealing it shut.

the-realisation.desc: SleepyTales #38605518 Since this is pride month, I'm going to do some vent work here (In a poem!) 'What do you think, dear?' My parents ask me one day Something evil that they agree with together The thing my eyes would roll off from I have to say something go…

diary-of-a-memeticist.desc: Check out my author page Your name is Becky. You are 15 years old. Three days ago, your father took you to a safe house. He said it was so you don't hurt anyone. You don't think it's necessary, but if your father says you should stay here, you probably should.…

all-you-people-are-vampires.desc: my best friend is leaving me to hang out with shady freaks. greg's pretty much been my only friend as long as i can remember, probably since elementary school, and as far as i know i'm his only friend as well. neither of us really wanted anyone else. we saw th…

slide-kid.desc: You probably don't remember me. In fact, you're probably realizing there's a lot of things you don't remember. As it turns out, I owe you a favor, so here's a story that might help you fill in some gaps.

nada-mada.desc: Nada, Mada! by xexnoncores Robert Shahid Carter is hot. Hot, bothered, and in need of a drink like he’s going to die within the hour.
